## Problem to Solve

What reading or listening task is difficult today?

## Suggested Behavior

Describe the desired experience and where it would appear in the app.

## Alternatives

Describe workarounds or simpler options you considered.

## Constraints

If relevant, explain offline/online requirements, accessibility needs, model licensing, device resources, and any privacy implications. Do not include credentials or private reading content.
